title: Gertman begins
author: Hempelson Tamsova
rules:
Once, as a student, young Grantem took a semester abroad in ancient Rome.

In a taverna, he met an old man who offered him a bet.

The fellow held up two fingers and said to Grantem that if he could drink that many sextarii of wine, the old man would cover his expenses for the whole semester.

"What's a sextarius?" Grantem asked, as the innkeeper brought a small calix of wine.

So two of them, Grantem thought to himself, that would be about a liter. I can handle this.

Confident of victory, Grantem agreed. As soon as he had finished the second calix and the innkeeper came with another cup of wine, he suddenly realized he wasn't even halfway through.
After the fourth calix, he resigned, and since that day he avoided the number 5 at all costs.

Yet after years of dread and avoidance, he decided to face his fear of fives.
Grantem became Gertman.

And so it begins..

Normal Sudoku rules apply.

Gertman's Whisper Lines:
Values of adjacent cells along a green line must differ by at least 5.
If a line appears anywhere in a column that column's 5 must sit somewhere on a line (each separate line must contain at least one 5). Every 5 in the grid has a unique value from 1-9 (the value of any digit that's not 5 always is the digit itself).

Clues:
Values of digits separated by a V sum to five; by an X sum to ten.
Cells separated by a triangle contain one odd and one even digit and never a 4,5 or 6.

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

Regarding the values of 5 for each row you can use the additional column for notes. (in SudokuPad)

solve with SudokuPad

P.s.

As a disclaimer, like always, I don't know the exact difficulty. I can quite confidently rule out 1*, and presumably 2*, but that's it. I hope you'll enjoy the puzzle nevertheless

P.P.s.

Gertman might return
solutionCode: Every value of 5 from row 1 to row 9 (in SudokuPad: the additional column top to bottom) + column 1 top to bottom (18 digits, no spaces inbetween)
